blocks.text:
Transfer to the airport early in the morning for your flight to Uyuni. Meet your local guides and set off for the village of Colchani.

Continue to the southern part of the Uyuni salt flat. Here you can see the “salt eyes”, openings in the surface where water from an underground river rises to the surface.

Enjoy a picnic lunch outdoors. After lunch, head to Incahuasi Island, where you’ll walk among giant cacti 8–12 metres tall. The island offers a panoramic view of the salt flat.

Around sunset, return to the edge of the salt flat to see its reflective surface and take photographs. Then return to check in at the hotel and rest.

**Meals:** light breakfast, picnic lunch.
Vehicle on the flooded Uyuni salt flat with clouds reflected in the water, Bolivia
Uyuni: a vehicle on the mirror-like salt flat beneath a reflected sky
Wednesday – Train Cemetery, Valley of the Rocks and small lagoons

After breakfast, visit the Train Cemetery and the village of San Cristóbal. Then head southwest to the Valley of the Rocks.

The route takes you past a chain of small lagoons: Cañapa, Hedionda, Chiarcota and Honda. You may see flamingos and other birds here.

Check in at a hotel at about 4,400 metres, then have dinner and rest.

**Meals:** breakfast, lunch, dinner.
